scope: Identity audit of frozen P2 CSVs, no phenotype/model refitting and no original changes.

identity_keys.actual_projected_genotype_identity: raw genotype header ecotype ID at panel_col, since P2 indexes genotype/block arrays directly
identity_keys.warning: Metadata row positions and raw genotype column positions use different orders; direct panel_col membership describes projected genotypes, not nominal Dryad names.

column_order_audit.interpretation: Training IDs align with the raw header. The 82/83 apparent training mismatch arises ONLY from indexing sorted metadata with raw columns, not from misordered training phenotypes.

source_evidence.fact: Genotype columns retain the raw header order; training genotype columns are reordered to phenotype IDs.
accessions_all.csv is independently sorted by ecotype_id.
dormancy_cols_in_1307.npy indexes the raw genotype header.
Name matching chooses metadata row positions; overlap flag uses exact names.
Metadata row positions are used directly as genotype/block columns without identity remapping.

ambiguities.resolution: The CSVs have no independent Dryad ecotype ID. Do not resolve same-name distinct ecotypes by arbitrary first/last choice; retain candidate lists and overlap bounds.

prediction_validity_warning: 205/206 frozen projections use a genotype identity different from the matched metadata identity. Regrouped metrics are forensic/descriptive only, not validated external accession performance. Correcting identity mapping and rerunning external projection is outside this audit.
leakage_semantics: Participation of external genotypes in SSL/preprocessing is transductive and is not itself phenotype leakage. Actual training-genotype reuse and incorrect accession identity invalidate independence/identity claims but do not prove Dryad phenotypes entered training. No such phenotype leakage is inferred here.
